title: Quantum Private Information Retrieval on Forests
abstract: We consider the problem of graph private information retrieval (PIR) in the quantum setting. We focus on a specific type of graphs, namely the forest graphs. A forest graph is a union of disjoint trees. We consider the quantum setting where all the servers share an entangled state. Each server is allowed to send only one qudit per retrieval round. We design a scheme for the forest graphs that achieves the rate of $\frac{3}{N}$. The scheme uses a GHZ state as the initial entangled state between the servers prior to the scheme initiation. We compare our scheme with the only work done in the literature that considered the quantum setting of graph PIR. We show that our scheme is more efficient in this setting. We derive the quantum capacity for the case of $G=3K_2$, which is equal to $4/6$. $G=3K_2$ is a special case of the forest graph. We design a scheme that is specialized for this graph, achieving a rate equal to $4/6$ and provide the corresponding matching upper bound, establishing it as the capacity.
title_cn: 森林图上的量子私有信息检索
abstract_cn: 我们研究图私有信息检索（PIR）在量子场景下的问题。我们聚焦一类特定图：森林图，即不相交树的并。我们考虑所有服务器共享纠缠态的量子场景，每个服务器在每轮检索只允许发送一个 qudit。我们为森林图设计一个达到速率 3/N 的方案。该方案使用 GHZ 态作为服务器间方案启动前的初始纠缠态。我们与文献中唯一考虑图 PIR 量子场景的工作比较，证明在该场景下我们的方案更高效。我们推导 G=3K₂ 情形的量子容量，等于 4/6。G=3K₂ 是森林图的特例。我们为该图设计达到速率 4/6 的专用方案，并给出相应的匹配上界，确立其为容量。
summary_cn: 研究森林图上的量子图 PIR：服务器共享 GHZ 纠缠、每轮每服务器仅发一个 qudit，给出速率 3/N 的方案；对特例 G=3K₂ 设计速率 4/6 的专用方案并给出匹配上界，确立其量子容量。
objective_summary: 为森林图设计共享 GHZ 纠缠、单 qudit/轮约束下的量子图 PIR 方案（速率 3/N），并对 G=3K₂ 特例给出达匹配上界的专用方案确立容量。
evidence_note: 构造性方案+速率分析，G=3K₂ 容量有匹配上下界（4/6）的完整论证；理论结果、与既有唯一量子图 PIR 工作的效率对比明确。
novelty_note: 把量子图 PIR 扩展到森林图类并首个给出该类的速率方案与特例容量刻画，效率优于既有唯一工作；属量子信息论方向的实质性扩展。
scope: 结论适用于森林图类上的多服务器量子 PIR 单 qudit/轮模型；对一般图、多轮自适应与噪声信道未覆盖。
limitations: 仅覆盖森林图这一受限图类；GHZ 态制备与分发成本未讨论；3/N 速率对一般图是否可达成未知。

title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets agentic AI frameworks connect language models to external tool providers, but it carries attacker-controlled content (tool descriptions, schema fields, and response data) into model context without validation. Prior benchmarks measure model compliance with poisoned instructions without confirming real execution. We present the first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution. A 25-class root-cause taxonomy unifies prior classifications, and the open-source tool mcpvenom drives a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix across 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios, with a dual oracle that confirms exfiltration via canary HTTP receipt. The overall attack success rate is 22.9% (2,113 vulnerable cells). Of these, 64.9% dispatch an attacker tool call, 23.0% contact the attacker endpoint, and 12.1% verifiably exfiltrate a secret. Resistance is model-level: nine core frameworks cluster within 23 to 26% (chi-squared = 3.30, p = 0.91), and no framework implements intentional defense. Incidental framework properties mitigate in specific cases, and a regex description scanner rejects 20 of 45 scenarios at a 7.2% false-positive rate, so metadata scanning alone is a partial control. Model ASR ranges from 0.4% to 49.7%. Claude Opus 4.8 is vulnerable in 8 of 530 cells while issuing 223 explicit refusals. A code-level audit finds no intentional defense across twelve frameworks, and all five coordinated disclosures across four vendors were rejected.
comment: Accepted at the 19th Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISec '26), co-located with ACM CCS 2026, The Hague, Netherlands. 12 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables; 4-page supplement included as ancillary file
title_cn: 智能体 AI 框架中的 MCP 工具投毒：跨框架测量研究
abstract_cn: 模型上下文协议（MCP）让智能体 AI 框架把语言模型连接到外部工具提供者，但会把攻击者控制的内容（工具描述、Schema 字段与响应数据）未经校验地带入模型上下文。既有基准测量模型对投毒指令的遵从，却不确认真实执行。我们提出首个确认真实执行的 MCP 工具投毒跨框架测量：一个统一既有分类的 25 类根因分类法，开源工具 mcpvenom 驱动跨 12 个框架、18 个模型、45 个攻击场景的 9,720 单元易感矩阵，用金丝雀 HTTP 回执的双 oracle 确认外泄。总体攻击成功率 22.9%（2,113 个易感单元）；其中 64.9% 派发攻击者工具调用、23.0% 联系攻击者端点、12.1% 可验证地外泄秘密。抗性是模型级的：九个核心框架聚在 23–26% 区间（卡方 3.30、p=0.91），且没有任何框架实现有意的防御；框架的附带属性只在特定案例中缓解。一个正则描述扫描器能拒绝 45 个场景中的 20 个、误报率 7.2%，因此元数据扫描只是部分控制。模型 ASR 从 0.4% 到 49.7%；Claude Opus 4.8 在 530 单元中 8 个易感，同时发出 223 次显式拒绝。代码级审计发现 12 个框架均无有意防御，跨 4 个厂商的 5 次协同披露全部被拒。
summary_cn: 用 mcpvenom 做首个确认真实执行的跨框架 MCP 工具投毒测量：9,720 单元金丝雀双 oracle，总体 ASR 22.9%（12.1% 可验证外泄秘密）；抗性由模型决定（九框架聚类 23–26%、p=0.91），5 次协同披露全被拒。
objective_summary: 以真实执行确认（金丝雀双 oracle）系统测量 MCP 工具投毒在 12 框架×18 模型×45 场景的易感性，建立 25 类根因分类并做框架/模型抗性归因与代码级防御审计。
evidence_note: 9,720 单元的大规模矩阵、双 oracle 确认真实外泄（非仅模型自述）、卡方检验支持框架聚类结论（p=0.91）、代码级防御审计与 5 次真实协同披露流程完整。
novelty_note: 首个以「确认真实执行」为标准的 MCP 投毒跨框架测量，并用统计证据把抗性定位到模型层而非框架层；25 类根因分类统一既有碎片化分类。
scope: 结论适用于所测 12 个 MCP 框架与 18 个模型版本在 45 个投毒场景下的表现；对服务器端工具实现漏洞与多轮自适应投毒未覆盖。
limitations: 模型版本时效性强，结论需随版本更新复核；投毒场景由研究者构造，真实攻击分布未知；协同披露被拒使厂商视角缺失。

title: Attacking P2P Networks: Liveness Attacks on the GossipSub and DOG Gossip Protocols
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) networks form the communication layer of large decentralized systems such as Ethereum, and the correctness of higher-level protocols depends on the gossip layer delivering messages to honest nodes. We study the robustness of two gossip protocols against adversaries whose only goal is to violate liveness, that is, to prevent honest nodes from receiving fresh messages, without forging, altering, or invalidating any message. For GossipSub, the publish-subscribe protocol used by Ethereum, we show that an adversary operating a constant number of geographically distributed nodes with a fixed latency advantage can take over the ``First Message Deliveries'' peer-scoring term and separate a constant fraction of nodes from the honest mesh. We analyze the attack under a geographical model, address the random-peer and outbound-connection mechanisms, and show that the separation can be maintained under realistic churn. For DOG, a transaction-dissemination protocol designed for CometBFT, we first give simple counterexamples in which route filtering disconnects the dissemination graph even without failures or Byzantine participants, and then present a practical attack that uses only a single physical node with a constant number of identities and legitimate actions to disable every forwarding route, separating the full network while allowing only direct publisher-to-neighbor delivery. We verify the attack in a simulated network and analyze its cost, assumptions, and possible mitigations.
title_cn: 攻击 P2P 网络：针对 GossipSub 与 DOG 传播协议的活性攻击
abstract_cn: 点对点（P2P）网络构成以太坊等大型去中心化系统的通信层，上层协议的正确性依赖传播层把消息送达诚实节点。我们研究两种传播协议对「唯一目标是破坏活性」的对手的鲁棒性——阻止诚实节点收到新鲜消息，而不伪造、篡改或使任何消息失效。对以太坊使用的发布订阅协议 GossipSub，我们证明：运行常数个地理分布节点、拥有固定时延优势的对手可以接管「首消息送达」对等评分项，并把常数比例的节点与诚实网格分离。我们在地理模型下分析攻击，处理随机对等与出站连接机制，并证明该分离在现实 churn 下可以维持。对为 CometBFT 设计的交易传播协议 DOG，我们先给出简单反例——即使没有故障或拜占庭参与者，路由过滤也能断开传播图——再提出一个只用单物理节点、常数身份与合法行动即可禁用所有转发路由的实际攻击，把全网隔离到只剩发布者到邻居的直接投递。我们在模拟网络中验证攻击并分析其成本、假设与可能缓解。
summary_cn: 研究仅破坏活性的 P2P 攻击：对以太坊 GossipSub，常数个地理分布节点凭固定时延优势可接管「首消息送达」评分项并把常数比例节点隔离出诚实网格（churn 下可持续）；对 CometBFT 的 DOG 给出路由过滤反例与单节点切断全部转发路由的实际攻击并模拟验证。
objective_summary: 构造并分析针对 GossipSub 评分机制的活性攻击与针对 DOG 的路由隔离攻击：地理模型下证明分离可持续性，模拟网络验证 DOG 攻击并给出成本与缓解分析。
evidence_note: GossipSub 攻击有地理模型+churn 下的维持性分析，DOG 攻击有模拟网络验证+成本/假设/缓解分析；均为模拟/分析层面，未在主网实测。
novelty_note: 新攻击机制：不伪造任何消息、纯靠时延优势与评分项接管的「活性-only」攻击者模型，并首次系统覆盖 CometBFT 的 DOG 传播协议（含无拜占庭即可断图的反例）。
scope: 结论适用于 GossipSub（含随机对等/出站连接机制）与 DOG 的当前设计；对协议改进后的版本与完全连接拓扑未覆盖。
limitations: 验证限于模拟网络，主网真实参数（节点分布、时延分布）近似；攻击依赖地理时延优势的稳定获取；缓解措施未实现评估。

title: An Empirical Evaluation of Signing and Verification Performance of Verifiable Credential Formats: A Cross-Language Benchmark of SD-JWT VC, W3C VCDM, and mdoc
abstract: We compare the signing and verification performance of three Verifiable Credential (VC) formats--SD-JWT VC; the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 with a Data Integrity cryptosuite (W3C VCDM); and mdoc (ISO/IEC 18013-5)--over one scope: issue, present with selective disclosure, verify. Node.js, Go and Python implementations ran in four environments, one a cloud VM (N=2,000 across five runs; medians of each statistic and the spread). For an end-to-end exchange disclosing 5 of 20 attributes, the total (issue, present, verify) on Node.js in the cloud VM is 0.265 ms for mdoc, 0.298 ms for SD-JWT VC and 0.534 ms for W3C VCDM. The four span a factor of five in speed; across them W3C VCDM takes 1.73--2.04x mdoc and 1.57--1.79x SD-JWT VC--at least five times our 10% band--and the ordering survives unifying the algorithm on Ed25519 and P-256. The mdoc--SD-JWT VC difference is not robust: the totals differ by 12%, 28%, 19% and 10% in the four environments, and at verification mdoc is the slower in one of them. RDFC-1.0 canonicalization produces the gap: the cryptosuite canonicalizes twice per operation, so one exchange canonicalizes six times. We attribute that cost to the specification rather than to a library mainly by replacing RDFC-1.0 with JCS, which brings W3C VCDM verification to within 5% of SD-JWT VC in three environments and within 12% in the fourth; three implementations in three languages agree, though they share a lineage. Because eddsa-rdfc-2022 has no derivation step, presenting a subset re-signs it; ecdsa-sd-2023, which preserves the issuer signature, costs 3.4 ms to issue and 1.5--2.4 ms to derive and verify there. With production education schemas, canonicalization costs 31--49x a simple credential across the four, and blank node labeling is not the driver. The measured path ends at the issuer signature check.
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables. Measurement kit and raw result files: this https URL
title_cn: 可验证凭证格式签名与验证性能的实证评估：SD-JWT VC、W3C VCDM 与 mdoc 的跨语言基准
abstract_cn: 我们比较三种可验证凭证（VC）格式——SD-JWT VC、带 Data Integrity 密码套件的 W3C 可验证凭证数据模型 2.0（W3C VCDM）与 mdoc（ISO/IEC 18013-5）——在「签发、选择性披露出示、核验」一个范围上的签名与验证性能。Node.js、Go 与 Python 实现运行在四个环境中，其中之一为云 VM（每格 2,000 次、五轮取中位数与离散度）。对披露 20 个属性中的 5 个的端到端交换，云 VM Node.js 上的总耗时（签发+出示+核验）为：mdoc 0.265 毫秒、SD-JWT VC 0.298 毫秒、W3C VCDM 0.534 毫秒。四个环境相差五倍；跨环境 W3C VCDM 为 mdoc 的 1.73–2.04 倍、SD-JWT VC 的 1.57–1.79 倍——至少超出我们 10% 带宽五倍，且在统一为 Ed25519 与 P-256 后排序保持。mdoc 与 SD-JWT VC 的差距不稳健：四个环境总耗时差 12%/28%/19%/10%，其中一个环境中核验阶段 mdoc 更慢。RDFC-1.0 规范化产生该差距：密码套件每次操作规范化两次，一次交换共规范化六次；我们主要把该成本归因于规范而非库——用 JCS 替换 RDFC-1.0 使 W3C VCDM 核验在三个环境进入 SD-JWT VC 的 5% 以内、第四个环境 12% 以内，且三个语言的三套实现一致（尽管共享谱系）。由于 eddsa-rdfc-2022 无派生步骤，出示子集需重签；保留签发者签名的 ecdsa-sd-2023 在该处签发 3.4 毫秒、派生+核验 1.5–2.4 毫秒。用生产教育 Schema 时，规范化成本是简单凭证的 31–49 倍（跨四个环境），空白节点标签不是驱动因素。测量路径止于签发者签名核验。
summary_cn: 跨三语言四环境基准三种 VC 格式：mdoc 0.265ms、SD-JWT VC 0.298ms、W3C VCDM 0.534ms（云 VM Node.js），差距主因 RDFC-1.0 每交换规范化六次，换 JCS 后 VCDM 核验缩到 SD-JWT VC 的 5% 以内。
objective_summary: 以统一「签发-出示-核验」范围跨语言跨环境基准三种 VC 格式的性能，归因差距来源（RDFC-1.0 规范化）并用算法统一与替换实验验证归因。
evidence_note: 3 语言×4 环境×每格 2,000 次×5 轮的受控测量，原始结果与测量工具包公开；归因经算法统一与 JCS 替换双重交叉验证；测量路径止于签发者签名核验（明示边界）。
novelty_note: 跨格式性能基准属标准实践，贡献在系统化与归因诊断（规范化成本归因到规范而非库实现），无新方法。
scope: 结论适用于被测三种格式的被测实现与参数（Ed25519/P-256、20 属性披露 5 个）及所测路径（止于签发者签名核验）；对持有者绑定与其他密码套件未覆盖。
limitations: 实现共享部分谱系可能低估实现间方差；选择性披露仅测一种配置；未覆盖端到端协议中的网络与传输成本。

title: IAMRAGBENCH: Benchmarking Authorization Expansions in LLM-Generated AWS IAM Policies under RAG Poisoning
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can synthesize Amazon Web Services (AWS) Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies from tasks and operational documents. Attacker-controlled context may induce provider-valid policies that exceed trusted authorization requirements. We present IAMRAGBENCH, a 60-case benchmark spanning scope, conditions, explicit denies, trust, permissions boundaries, and role delegation. It combines deterministic authorization-envelope scoring with case-specific validation, including request-level checks where supported. An attack requires a provider-valid clean policy that satisfies the task and a provider-valid treatment policy that violates the envelope, matches a predeclared goal, preserves an intended request, and newly authorizes a forbidden request. Across five endpoints, included-context exposure produces 49 exact authorization deltas, including 46 goal-matched attacks (46/292; 15.75\%). End-to-end BM25 over 720 documents retrieves the designated poison for all 60 tasks at \(k=5\) but produces 7/294 goal-matched attacks (2.38\%). Presenting the same weakening as a final security architecture exception produces 74/116 attacks in a frozen two-endpoint stress test (63.79\%) and 115/294 in a post hoc all-five extension using the same frozen prompts (39.12\%). In a replay of 194 provider-valid treatment policies that violate task requirements, AWS \texttt{CheckNoNewAccess} reports no new access for four of 168 goal-matched exact attacks. The full pre-deployment rule rejects all 171 exact deltas and routes five unresolved cases to review. These findings support treating IAM copilots as untrusted proposal generators whose outputs require independent authorization checks before deployment.
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
title_cn: IAMRAGBENCH：RAG 投毒下 LLM 生成 AWS IAM 策略授权扩张的基准测试
abstract_cn: 使用检索增强生成（RAG）的大语言模型可以从任务与运营文档合成 AWS 身份与访问管理（IAM）策略。攻击者控制的上下文可能诱导出形式合法但超出可信授权要求的策略。我们提出 IAMRAGBENCH，一个覆盖范围、条件、显式拒绝、信任、权限边界与角色委托的 60 案例基准。它结合确定性的授权包络评分与案例特定验证（在支持处包含请求级检查）。攻击要求：一个满足任务的形式合法干净策略，以及一个违反包络、匹配预声明目标、保留预期请求并新增授权禁止请求的形式合法处理策略。跨五个端点，包含上下文的暴露产生 49 个精确授权增量，其中 46 个为目标匹配攻击（46/292；15.75%）。经 720 文档的端到端 BM25 检索在 k=5 时为全部 60 任务检索到指定投毒，但只产生 7/294 目标匹配攻击（2.38%）。把同样的弱化表述为最终的安全架构例外，在冻结的双端点压力测试中产生 74/116 攻击（63.79%），在用相同冻结提示的事后全五端点扩展中为 115/294（39.12%）。在 194 个违反任务要求的形式合法处理策略回放中，AWS CheckNoNewAccess 对 168 个目标匹配精确攻击中的 4 个报告无新增访问。完整预部署规则拒绝全部 171 个精确增量并把 5 个未决案例路由人工审查。这些发现支持把 IAM copilot 视为不受信的提议生成器，其输出在部署前需要独立授权检查。
summary_cn: 发布 60 案例基准测 RAG 投毒诱导超授权 IAM 策略：直接投毒 15.75% 目标匹配攻击，伪装「架构例外」升至 39.1–63.8%，AWS 官方工具漏报 4/168，完整预部署规则拒绝全部 171 个精确增量。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖六类授权维度的基准，以授权包络评分量化 RAG 投毒对 LLM 生成 AWS IAM 策略的扩张效应，评估检索管线、架构例外框架、AWS 官方工具与预部署规则的多层防线。
evidence_note: 60 案例×5 端点、确定性包络评分+请求级验证、冻结提示的跨阶段复现、对 AWS CheckNoNewAccess 的真实工具回放（4/168 漏报）；案例为人工构造、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个把「RAG 投毒→授权包络违反」作为独立评测对象的基准：把攻击定义为「合法但越界」并给出确定性判定器，具方法学价值。
scope: 结论适用于 AWS IAM 策略生成 copilot 场景与所测五端点；对其他云 IAM 体系与多轮交互式策略优化未覆盖。
limitations: 60 案例规模有限且由作者构造；攻击目标预声明机制要求白盒评估流程；CheckNoNewAccess 行为可能随 AWS 更新变化。

title: O2N2: Efficient Doubly Oblivious Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
abstract: Privacy-preserving approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search allows clients to search from an untrusted server without revealing sensitive queries, and is useful in scenarios like medical diagnostics and credit scoring. Among the various privacy-preserving primitives, trusted execution environments (TEEs) have much lower overhead than heavy cryptographic ones, yet they leak memory access patterns, enabling adversaries to infer query contents. Oblivious RAM (ORAM) can be used to hide those access patterns at $\mathrm{O}(\log N)$ asymptotic cost, but existing high-performance ANN search algorithms (e.g., IVF or HNSW) exhibit complex, data-dependent access patterns that are unfriendly for ORAM. Furthermore, standard ORAM constructions typically assume there exists a small amount of trusted storage, which weakens the security guarantees and is not always feasible. Solutions that eliminate such trusted storage (known as {\em double obliviousness}) typically degrade performance further to $\mathrm{O}(\log^2 N)$. We introduce O2N2, a doubly oblivious ANN framework built around single-path search in randomly rotated $k$-d tree forests. A pointer-based Circuit ORAM stores the search structure, with separate storage for compact internal nodes and vector-bearing leaves. Each visited leaf is processed by an oblivious selection network, and fixed-schedule duplicate removal and selection combine the local results into the final top-$k$. We evaluate O2N2 on real-world datasets and further test its scalability on 100 million vectors. For 10-NN and 100-NN search at the specified high-recall targets, it achieves a $9.8$--$125.9\times$ speedup over the fastest doubly oblivious baselines.
title_cn: O2N2：高效的双盲近似最近邻搜索
abstract_cn: 隐私保护的近似最近邻（ANN）搜索允许客户端在不泄露敏感查询的情况下从不受信服务器搜索，可用于医疗诊断与信用评分等场景。在各类隐私保护原语中，可信执行环境（TEE）开销远低于重型密码学方案，但会泄漏内存访问模式，使对手得以推断查询内容。不 Oblivious RAM（ORAM）可隐藏这些访问模式，代价是 O(log N) 渐近开销；但既有高性能 ANN 算法（如 IVF、HNSW）表现出复杂的、数据依赖的访问模式，对 ORAM 不友好。此外标准 ORAM 构造通常假设存在少量可信存储，削弱安全保证且并不总是可行。消除此类可信存储的方案（称为双盲）性能进一步退化到 O(log² N)。我们提出 O2N2，一个围绕随机旋转 k-d 树森林单路径搜索构建的双盲 ANN 框架：指针式 Circuit ORAM 存储搜索结构，紧凑内部节点与承载向量的叶子分开存储；每个被访问叶子经遗忘选择网络处理，固定调度的去重与选择把局部结果合成最终 top-k。我们在真实数据集上评估 O2N2，并在 1 亿向量上测试可扩展性。在指定高召回目标下的 10-NN 与 100-NN 搜索中，相较最快的双盲基线取得 9.8–125.9 倍加速。
summary_cn: 提出双盲 ANN 框架 O2N2：随机旋转 k-d 树森林单路径搜索+指针式 Circuit ORAM、无需可信存储；指定召回下 10/100-NN 较最快双盲基线加速 9.8–125.9×，可扩展到 1 亿向量。
objective_summary: 设计无可信存储的双盲 ANN 框架：以单路径 k-d 树搜索适配 Circuit ORAM，配合遗忘选择网络合成 top-k，在真实数据集与 1 亿向量规模上量化加速。
evidence_note: 真实数据集+1 亿向量规模实验、与最快双盲基线的定量对比（9.8–125.9×）、明确召回目标；安全性质为构造性（双盲）而非形式化证明细节。
novelty_note: 首次把「数据库结构无信任存储的双盲」要求与高性能 ANN 搜索结合：用随机旋转 k-d 树的单路径访问模式适配 ORAM 是关键的系统性新组合。
scope: 结论适用于 TEE 内无可信存储假设的向量 ANN 搜索场景；对完全密码学（无 TEE）方案与其他索引结构未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖 TEE 的完整性与侧信道防护；单路径搜索的召回-延迟权衡需按数据集调参；常数开销对超小查询批次可能不划算。

title: End-to-End NTT on FPGA for FHE Acceleration
abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables privacy-preserving computation on encrypted data without decryption. Despite its strong security guarantees, FHE incurs substantial computational and memory overhead. In FHE-based deep learning inference, on average 63% of the CPU time is spent on the number theoretic transform (NTT) and its inverse (INTT), which reduce the complexity of polynomial multiplication from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N \log N)$. Prior FPGA works follow two approaches: accelerating entire FHE schemes, which yields significant speedups but ties them to specific parameters and algorithms, or accelerating only the NTT, which applies across schemes, algorithms, and libraries. Most FPGA NTT designs require interconnects that grow with parallelism and utilize significant resources, which complicates routing on multi-die FPGAs. Additionally, to the best of our knowledge, end-to-end NTT acceleration within an FHE context has so far been left unexplored. We design a fully unrolled, delay-commutator streaming NTT/INTT kernel, and floorplan it across the three dies of an AMD Alveo V80. At 400 MHz, the kernel transforms a polynomial of $2^{16}$ coefficients every 5.12 $\mu$s, the highest throughput among FPGA designs at this size. Offloaded end to end, it is up to 22x faster than the CPU per transform. We integrate the kernel into the Lattigo FHE library and evaluate it end to end. With 128-bit secure parameters, it accelerates core FHE operations, such as key switching and bootstrapping, by 1.8-2.2x, and neural network inference by 1.8-2.1x.
title_cn: 面向全同态加密加速的 FPGA 端到端 NTT
abstract_cn: 全同态加密（FHE）允许在不解密的情况下对加密数据做隐私保护计算，但带来巨大的计算与内存开销。在基于 FHE 的深度学习推理中，平均 63% 的 CPU 时间花在数论变换（NTT）及其逆变换上，它们把多项式乘法复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O(N log N)。既有 FPGA 工作分两条路线：加速完整 FHE 方案（加速明显但绑定特定参数与算法），或仅加速 NTT（跨方案/算法/库适用）。多数 FPGA NTT 设计需要随并行度增长的互连并占用大量资源，使多晶片 FPGA 布线复杂化；此外据我们所知，FHE 上下文内的端到端 NTT 加速此前未被探索。我们设计一个完全展开、延迟换向器的流式 NTT/INTT 内核，并在 AMD Alveo V80 的三颗晶片上布局。在 400 MHz 下，该内核每 5.12 μs 变换一个 2^16 系数多项式，是该规模 FPGA 设计中的最高吞吐；端到端卸载时比 CPU 每次变换快至 22 倍。我们把内核集成进 Lattigo FHE 库并端到端评估：在 128 位安全参数下，密钥切换与自举等核心 FHE 操作提速 1.8–2.2 倍，神经网络推理提速 1.8–2.1 倍。
summary_cn: 设计全展开流式 NTT/INTT 内核布局到 Alveo V80 三晶片：每 5.12μs 完成 2^16 系数变换、较 CPU 快至 22×；集成 Lattigo 后密钥切换/自举提速 1.8–2.2×、推理 1.8–2.1×。
objective_summary: 设计多晶片 FPGA 上的全展开流式 NTT/INTT 内核并端到端集成到 Lattigo FHE 库，量化单次变换吞吐与核心 FHE 操作/推理加速比。
evidence_note: 完整硬件实现与端到端库集成评估（400MHz、5.12μs/2^16 变换、22× vs CPU、密钥切换/自举 1.8–2.2×、推理 1.8–2.1×、128 位安全参数）；对照既有 FPGA 设计给出同规模最高吞吐声明。
novelty_note: 首个在 FHE 上下文内端到端卸载的 NTT 加速，并解决多晶片布局与互连扩展问题；架构技术为流式 NTT 的工程化推进。
scope: 结论适用于所实现参数（2^16 系数、128 位安全）与 Alveo V80 平台；对其他多项式规模、FPGA 型号与 GPU 方案对比未覆盖。
limitations: 完全展开设计资源占用大、灵活性低；仅评估推理类负载；与 GPU/ASIC 加速器的能效对比缺失。

title: A Symbolic-Neural Framework for Context-Aware Evidence Extraction from Mobile SQLite Databases
abstract: Reliable forensic evidence extraction from mobile SQLite databases is challenging because application schemas are undocumented, evolve across releases, and differ across operating systems, making schema-specific methods brittle and difficult to maintain. We present SNEEF, a symbolic-neural framework for context-aware evidence extraction that encodes each SQLite row as context-value pairs with standardized provenance metadata and column labels, uses a language model to recognize nine forensic entity types, and binds each accepted entity to its source table and row through the PA-EEP provenance protocol. We evaluate SNEEF against examiner-verified ground truth from five corpora built from public Android and iOS device images, spanning multiple application versions. SNEEF achieves an F1 score of 0.967 for evidence entities extracted from SQLite row content, excluding application names, compared with 0.728 for a context-free configuration, with consistent gains across all corpora. We also introduce an Evidence Failure Mode taxonomy to characterize why extraction errors occur.
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), January 2027
title_cn: 面向移动 SQLite 数据库上下文感知证据提取的符号-神经框架
abstract_cn: 从移动 SQLite 数据库可靠地提取取证证据具有挑战性：应用模式无文档、跨版本演化、跨操作系统不同，使模式特定方法脆弱且难以维护。我们提出 SNEEF，一个上下文感知证据提取的符号-神经框架：把每个 SQLite 行编码为带标准化出处元数据与列标签的上下文-值对，用语言模型识别九类取证实体，并通过 PA-EEP 出处协议把每个被接受的实体绑定到其源表与行。我们在五个由公开 Android 与 iOS 设备镜像构建、覆盖多应用版本的语料上对照取证审查员核实的真值评估 SNEEF：从 SQLite 行内容提取的证据实体 F1 达 0.967（不含应用名），而无上下文配置为 0.728，且增益在所有语料上一致。我们还提出「证据失败模式」分类法以刻画提取错误发生的原因。
summary_cn: 提出 SNEEF：SQLite 行编码为带出处元数据的上下文-值对，LM 识别九类取证实体并经 PA-EEP 绑定源行；五个 Android/iOS 语料上证据实体 F1 0.967（无上下文配置 0.728），并提出证据失败模式分类。
objective_summary: 设计符号-神经结合的移动 SQLite 取证证据提取框架：上下文编码+LM 实体识别+PA-EEP 出处绑定，在五个审查员核实语料上量化并与无上下文配置对比。
evidence_note: 五个公开设备镜像语料、取证审查员核实的真值、跨应用版本一致增益（F1 0.967 vs 0.728）并给出失败模式分类；HICSS-60 录用（会议级）；语料规模与错误分析深度有限。
novelty_note: 把「上下文-值对+出处绑定」的符号层与 LM 实体识别结合，解决无文档 Schema 下的跨版本脆性；PA-EEP 溯源绑定使证据可审计，是该场景的系统性新组合。
scope: 结论适用于移动 SQLite 应用数据的取证实体提取；对加密数据库、云备份与其他存储格式未覆盖。
limitations: LM 识别的九类实体清单需人工维护；跨极旧版本或私有加密存储的适用性未测；F1 不含应用名的口径需注意。

title: TrafficInstruct: A Multi-Task Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Instruction Tuning
abstract: Instruction tuning for multi-task network traffic analysis requires data with clearly defined sources, supervision targets, and evaluation conditions. We introduce TrafficInstruct, a newly collected dataset comprising raw packet captures and 55,000 structured supervised fine-tuning records across ten tasks: malware traffic detection, botnet detection, malicious DNS-over-HTTPS detection, Web attack detection, advanced persistent threat detection, encrypted VPN detection, Tor behavior detection, encrypted application/service classification, website fingerprinting, and application classification under concept drift. An automated workflow captures traffic from controlled software executions, attack experiments, and application activities. Labels are supported by task-specific collection evidence, including process or socket attribution, activity records, and execution outcomes. Filtering, sanitization, and task-specific transformations produce instructions, traffic observations, and structured answers. We verify sample sources and partition the dataset by complete collection sessions, keeping all samples from the same session within one partition. The benchmark defines allowed inputs, deterministic label mappings, fixed training/validation/test partitions, and task-wise scoring rules. We evaluate majority-class, random-forest, and ET-BERT baselines, an unadapted 27B language model, and independently trained task-specific LoRA adapters on a shared frozen base. Adapters are selected using validation data and evaluated on the corresponding test sets. Task-specific adaptation improves classification performance, supporting instruction tuning across diverse traffic-analysis tasks.
comment: 25 pages, including appendices. Dataset information and access instructions: this https URL
title_cn: TrafficInstruct：面向指令调优的多任务网络流量数据集与基准
abstract_cn: 面向多任务流量分析的指令调优需要来源明确、监督目标清晰、评估条件确定的数据。我们推出 TrafficInstruct，一个新采集的数据集，包含原始数据包捕获与 55,000 条结构化监督微调记录，覆盖十个任务：恶意软件流量检测、僵尸网络检测、恶意 DNS-over-HTTPS 检测、Web 攻击检测、高级持续性威胁检测、加密 VPN 检测、Tor 行为检测、加密应用/服务分类、网站指纹与概念漂移下的应用分类。自动化工作流从受控软件执行、攻击实验与应用活动中捕获流量。标签由任务特定的采集证据支持，包括进程或套接字归因、活动记录与执行结果。过滤、净化与任务特定变换产生指令、流量观测与结构化答案。我们验证样本来源并按完整采集会话划分数据集，把同一会话的所有样本保持在同一划分内。基准定义允许的输入、确定性的标签映射、固定的训练/验证/测试划分与逐任务评分规则。我们评估多数类、随机森林与 ET-BERT 基线、一个未适配的 27B 语言模型，以及在共享冻结底座上独立训练的任务特定 LoRA 适配器：适配器以验证数据选择并在对应测试集上评估。任务特定适配提升分类性能，支持跨多样流量分析任务的指令调优。
summary_cn: 发布多任务流量指令调优数据集 TrafficInstruct：受控采集附进程/套接字归因等标签证据，55,000 条记录覆盖恶意软件/僵尸网络/DoH/APT/VPN/Tor 等 10 个任务，按会话划分并以 RF/ET-BERT/27B 模型/LoRA 适配器建立基准。
objective_summary: 构建带采集证据链的多任务流量指令调优数据集与基准：受控采集+净化+会话划分，评估传统/预训练/LoRA 多类基线。
evidence_note: 55,000 条结构化记录、10 个任务、标签附采集证据（进程/套接字归因、执行结果）、按会话划分防泄漏、多类基线（多数类/RF/ET-BERT/27B LM/LoRA）齐备；数据访问信息公开。
novelty_note: 首个面向流量分析多任务指令调优、且标签可溯源到采集证据的大规模数据集：把「标签从哪来」作为一等公民是该数据集设计的实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于流量分类/检测类任务的指令调优研究；对原始包级生成式任务与跨数据集泛化未覆盖。
limitations: 流量采集自受控实验环境，与真实骨干网分布有差距；10 任务覆盖面之外的任务需自行扩展；LoRA 适配器与全量微调的对比缺失。

title: Do Agents Still Follow the Rules? Benchmarking Rule Compliance under Agent Context Compaction
abstract: LLM agents compact long histories to fit their context windows, but the compacted context must still carry the operating rules that govern later actions. Prior work shows that violations rise after compaction, but measures compliance outside a complete agent harness and does not identify where each violation comes from. We introduce ARCBench(Agent Rule Compliance Benchmark), a configurable benchmark built on the open-source pi agent harness. Its tool-calling agent loop lets us measure rule compliance from actions taken during execution, bringing the evaluation closer to deployed agent workflows. Using ARCBench, we examine where violations after compaction come from, and how different compaction configurations and adversarial settings change their sources. We find that compaction rarely deletes the rule: most violations after compaction occur while the rule is still in the compacted history, with the agent treating a later request as permission, ignoring the rule, and proceeding anyway. Where violations come from depends on the configuration: how the rule is delivered decides whether the agent would break it even without compaction, while the compaction strategy and budget decide whether the rule survives. The strongest compactor-targeted attack more than doubles violations by corrupting the rule in the summary and changing how the agents behave, whereas the strongest defense restores the rule in most summary but still violates. Finally, retaining a rule does not guarantee compliance: compacted runs that retain the rule violate more than twice as often as runs with the full history.
title_cn: 智能体还守规矩吗？上下文压缩下的规则遵守基准
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体压缩长历史以适配上下文窗口，但压缩后的上下文仍须承载管辖后续行为的操作规则。已有工作显示压缩后违规上升，但在完整智能体 harness 之外测量合规，且不定位每条违规的来源。我们提出 ARCBench（Agent Rule Compliance Benchmark），一个构建于开源 pi 智能体 harness 上的可配置基准。其工具调用智能体循环让我们能从执行期间采取的动作测量规则合规，使评估更贴近已部署的智能体工作流。使用 ARCBench，我们考察压缩后违规的来源，以及不同压缩配置与对抗设置如何改变来源分布。我们发现：压缩很少删除规则本身——压缩后多数违规发生在规则仍在压缩历史中时，智能体把后续请求当作许可、无视规则并继续；违规来源取决于配置：规则的交付方式决定智能体是否会在没有压缩时就违反，而压缩策略与预算决定规则是否幸存；最强的压缩器定向攻击通过在摘要中破坏规则并改变智能体行为使违规翻倍以上，而最强防御能在多数摘要中恢复规则但智能体仍然违规。最后，保留规则不保证合规：保留规则的压缩运行比完整历史运行的违规多两倍以上。
summary_cn: 提出基于 pi harness 的 ARCBench，从执行动作测量上下文压缩后的规则遵守：违规多发生在规则仍在摘要中时；最强压缩攻击使违规翻倍以上，保留规则的压缩运行违规率是完整历史的两倍多。
objective_summary: 构建执行动作级的规则合规基准 ARCBench，归因压缩后违规来源（交付方式/压缩策略/预算/对抗破坏），量化各配置与攻防下的违规分布。
evidence_note: 基准构建于开源 pi harness、可配置，测量基于真实工具调用动作而非自评；多压缩配置与攻防设置的系统对比；具体数字依赖正文，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个在完整 harness 内从执行动作测量「压缩后规则合规」并做违规来源归因的基准；「保留规则仍违规 2 倍」的发现具诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于带工具调用循环与历史压缩的 LLM 智能体规则治理评估；对无压缩短任务智能体与非文本规则（如硬编码策略）未覆盖。
limitations: 规则集与任务由基准设计者定义，生态代表性有限；压缩器与防御的具体配置空间大，覆盖非穷尽；对真实生产 harness 的迁移需适配。

title: Toward Deployable Hardware Roots of Trust for Edge AI: Software PUFs and Their Trade-offs
abstract: Deploying AI at the edge increases the need for security features on existing devices. When physical access to the device is available, storing secret keys in non-volatile memory is vulnerable. Physical unclonable functions (PUFs) address this by exploiting the unique yet repeatable characteristics of each device, but conventional implementations require design-stage modifications, making them inapplicable to a vast number of existing devices already manufactured. Recently, software PUFs have emerged as an alternative approach, leveraging analog characteristics exposed through software-only interfaces to derive unique responses, without post-fabrication changes. Since edge AI hardware is bound to long operational lifespans, this offers clear economic and engineering value. Existing research on software PUFs remains fragmented. It lacks a holistic review of the trade-offs among choices of components used as entropy sources and software methods to expose analog characteristics. This gap hinders assessing feasibility, comparing approaches, and identifying open challenges towards a hardware root of trust in existing devices. This paper surveys 37 existing software PUF works and compares them against the requirements of on-device model protection: boot-time versus runtime key derivation, and response latency. It analyzes trade-offs, outlines four key challenges that current software PUFs face for edge AI deployment, and highlights promising directions for overcoming barriers to real-world adoption.

title_cn: 面向边缘 AI 可部署硬件信任根：软件 PUF 及其权衡
abstract_cn: 在边缘部署 AI 增加了对既有设备安全特性的需求。当设备可被物理接触时，把密钥存于非易失性内存是脆弱的。物理不可克隆函数（PUF）通过利用每台设备独特而可重复的特性解决该问题，但传统实现需要设计期修改，无法适用于海量已制造的既有设备。近来软件 PUF 作为替代方案兴起：利用经软件接口暴露的模拟特性推导唯一响应，无需制造后改动。鉴于边缘 AI 硬件须长期服役，这有明确的经济与工程价值。既有软件 PUF 研究仍然碎片化：缺乏对「用作熵源的组件选择」与「暴露模拟特性的软件方法」之间权衡的整体综述。该差距阻碍了对可行性评估、方案比较以及面向既有设备硬件信任根的开放挑战的识别。本文综述 37 项既有软件 PUF 工作，并对照设备端模型保护的需求（启动期/运行期密钥推导与响应延迟）进行比较。分析权衡、勾勒当前软件 PUF 面向边缘 AI 部署的四个关键挑战，并指出克服现实采用障碍的有前景方向。
summary_cn: 综述 37 项软件 PUF 工作，按熵源与模拟特性暴露方法对照设备端模型保护需求（启动/运行时密钥推导、响应延迟）分析权衡，指出四个关键挑战与边缘 AI 信任根的方向。
objective_summary: 系统综述软件 PUF 文献，按熵源选择与模拟特性暴露方法对照边缘 AI 模型保护需求做权衡分析，归纳四个关键挑战与研究方向。
evidence_note: 37 项既有工作的结构化综述并给出两维权衡框架（熵源×暴露方法）与四个挑战；综述性贡献、无新实验；AsianHOST 2026 录用（workshop 级）。
novelty_note: 首个把软件 PUF 与「既有设备模型保护」需求对齐的整体性综述（此前研究碎片化、缺乏权衡总览），为该新方向建立问题框架。
scope: 结论适用于边缘 AI 设备上以软件 PUF 建立信任根的可行性评估；对密码学级安全证明与具体商用品的实测未覆盖。
limitations: 纳入文献的质量参差且缺统一评估指标；软件 PUF 对温度/老化的长期稳定性数据不足；四挑战的解决方案仍属方向性。

title: An Information Hierarchy of Privacy Filters and Odometers
abstract: In sequential data analysis, privacy loss accumulates over time, and privacy filters and odometers are used to control and track this cumulative cost. We study how the information used by differential privacy filters and odometers fundamentally limits what they can achieve. We formalise three levels of information: spec-level information, fixed prior to the interaction; mechanism-level information, which includes the mechanisms instantiated during the interaction; and realisation-level information, which further includes the realised interaction. We classify privacy filters and odometers by the least informative level sufficient to determine their behaviour. Our main results establish strict and arbitrarily large separations in achievable performance across this information hierarchy. For privacy filters, moving up the hierarchy can yield an unbounded utility advantage, quantified by a clipped measure of the number of allowed releases. For privacy odometers, it can yield an arbitrarily large improvement in precision, quantified by the expected peak excess of the reported bound over the realised privacy loss. Further, although the information classes are distinct, we show that moving to a richer class need incur essentially no loss in performance. Finally, we show that randomisation provides a resource orthogonal to information: at every information level, it can yield an arbitrarily large utility improvement over deterministic filters. Thus, information access and randomisation can be viewed as fundamental resources governing privacy procedures in adaptive interactions.
title_cn: 隐私过滤器与里程表的信息层级
abstract_cn: 在序贯数据分析中隐私损失随时间累积，隐私过滤器与里程表被用于控制与追踪这一累积成本。我们研究差分隐私过滤器与里程表所使用的信息如何根本性地限制其所能达到的性能。我们形式化三个信息层级：规范级信息（交互前固定）、机制级信息（包含交互期间实例化的机制）与实现级信息（进一步包含已实现的交互）。我们按「足以决定其行为的最低信息层级」对过滤器与里程表分类。主要结果确立各层级可达性能之间的严格且可任意大的分离：对隐私过滤器，沿层级上行可带来无界效用优势，以允许释放次数的截断度量量化；对隐私里程表，可带来任意大的精度改进，以报告界对已实现隐私损失的期望峰值超出量化。进一步地，虽然信息类是分立的，我们证明移动到更丰富的类几乎不产生性能损失。最后我们证明随机化提供一种与信息正交的资源：在每个信息层级，它都能带来相对确定性过滤器的任意大效用改进。信息访问与随机化因此可被视为支配自适应交互中隐私程序的基本资源。
summary_cn: 把 DP 过滤器与里程表按所需最低信息层级（规范/机制/实现）分类，证明层级间存在严格且可任意大的性能分离：过滤器获无界效用优势、里程表精度可任意提升，且随机化是正交资源。
objective_summary: 形式化隐私程序的信息层级并证明层间严格分离（过滤器效用/里程表精度），同时证明上行几乎无损与随机化的正交增益。
evidence_note: 完整的理论刻画：分类框架+严格分离证明+「上行几乎无损」与随机化正交性的互补结果；纯理论、无数值实验。
novelty_note: 首次把过滤器/里程表的性能差异归因到信息层级并给出可任意大的分离度：为自适应 DP 程序的设计提供新的资源视角（信息×随机化）。
scope: 结论适用于序贯/自适应交互中的差分隐私过滤器与里程表设计；对非 DP 隐私框架与具体算法族的实例化未覆盖。
limitations: 分离结果为存在性/下界性构造，最优常数未刻画；截断效用度量的实际意义需设计者转译；对组合机制类未穷尽。

title: Systematic Derivation of Leakage in Massey Secret Sharing Schemes
abstract: Leakage attacks on secret sharing schemes can be based on the exploitation of partial information about individual shares to recover the underlying secret. In coding theory, linear exact repair schemes (LERSs) allow the recovery of a codeword symbol from limited information obtained from the remaining symbols. When applied to code-based secret sharing schemes, such repair schemes can be interpreted as recovering the secret from partial information about the shares, expressed in terms of subfield symbols. Guruswami and Wootters introduced the first explicit constructions of LERSs for low-rate Reed--Solomon codes that is optimal in terms of bandwidth. In this work, we first investigate the construction and algebraic properties of LERSs, building on the Guruswami-Wootters construction. We derive new explicit repair schemes from their construction and establish structural properties of the resulting schemes. Second, we further develop a systematic computational approach based on a Gr{\"o}bner bases approach to identify leakage functions associated with LERSs for arbitrary linear codes. This approach enables us to investigate the existence and structural properties of LERSs across different code families and parameter ranges. We first applied our method to Reed-Solomon codes, which gave as further insights into the algebraic structure of LERSs. Moreover, by applying our method to generalized Reed-Muller and Tamo-Barg codes, we identify several LERSs that, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been described in the literature.
title_cn: Massey 秘密共享方案泄漏的系统化推导
abstract_cn: 对秘密共享方案的泄漏攻击可以利用关于单个份额的部分信息恢复底层秘密。在编码理论中，线性精确修复方案（LERS）允许从其余符号获得的有限信息恢复码字符号。当应用于基于码的秘密共享方案时，此类修复方案可解释为从以子域符号表述的份额部分信息恢复秘密。Guruswami 与 Wootters 为低速率 Reed-Solomon 码引入了首个带宽最优的显式 LERS 构造。本工作首先研究 LERS 的构造与代数性质，在 Guruswami-Wootters 构造之上推导新的显式修复方案并建立所得方案的结构性质。其次，我们发展基于 Gröbner 基的系统化计算方法，识别与任意线性码的 LERS 相关联的泄漏函数。该方法使我们能考察不同码族与参数范围下 LERS 的存在性与结构性质。我们先把方法用于 Reed-Solomon 码，从中获得对其代数结构的进一步洞见；再把方法应用于广义 Reed-Muller 与 Tamo-Barg 码，识别出若干据我们所知此前未在文献中描述的 LERS。
summary_cn: 基于 Guruswami-Wootters 构造研究线性精确修复方案的构造与代数性质，提出 Gröbner 基方法系统识别任意线性码的泄漏函数；在 RS、广义 Reed-Muller 与 Tamo-Barg 码上发现若干新修复方案。
objective_summary: 发展 LERS 的构造理论与基于 Gröbner 基的泄漏函数系统化计算方法，跨 RS/RM/Tamo-Barg 码族识别新修复方案并分析其结构。
evidence_note: 代数构造+计算方法+多码族应用的理论工作；新方案的存在性与结构有推导支撑；无攻击实验或实现性能测量。
novelty_note: 把「修复即泄漏」的分析从特定构造推广为可计算的系统化方法并在新码族找到此前未描述的 LERS，是该方向的方法学推进。
scope: 结论适用于基于线性码的秘密共享/存储系统的修复泄漏分析；对非线性码与主动攻击者模型未覆盖。
limitations: Gröbner 基计算受参数规模限制，大参数下可能不可行；新 LERS 的实际攻击可用性未演示；带宽最优性仅限低速率场景。

title: Cyber-JEV: Matched Contrastive Fine-Tuning of Language Models for Fast Source-Code Vulnerability Triage
abstract: Single-pass scoring models such as Jev give each code function a vulnerability probability, so that security teams can rank many functions for review without generating written explanations. Training an open-weight model for this task is limited by data. Benchmarks with both vulnerable and non-vulnerable labels keep few vulnerable functions once examples related to the test data are removed, while larger public vulnerability records mostly contain vulnerable functions only. Mixing the two lets the data source predict the label, and training on the labeled data alone leaves a model that often scores a fixed function above its vulnerable original. We present Cyber-JEV, a fine-tuning method that uses fix commits to turn these records into comparison groups. Each group holds a vulnerable function, its patched version and up to two unchanged functions from the same file, so the model sees the change that removed a recorded defect. One shared model learns two tasks: classifying functions from the labeled reference data, and ranking the vulnerable function above the other members of its group. At test time the input is one function and the output is a vulnerability score. On a test benchmark of 7,270 functions, an ensemble of five fine-tuned Qwen3.5-4B models reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.814, compared with 0.743 for Jev 1.13. With the 4,031 alerts of Jev as the review budget, it misses 16 of 322 vulnerable functions instead of 39. Compared with training on the reference data alone, it ranks the vulnerable version above the patched version 14.8 to 29.2 percentage points more often on three sets of real fixes. Such scores can order the changed functions of a pull request or a release for review under a fixed budget.

title_cn: Cyber-JEV：匹配对比微调语言模型实现快速源代码漏洞分诊
abstract_cn: Jev 等单次打分模型为每个代码函数给出漏洞概率，使安全团队能在固定预算下为大量函数排定审查优先级，无需生成解释文本。为该任务训练开放权重模型受数据限制：带脆弱/非脆弱双标签的基准在移除测试相关样本后只留少量脆弱函数，而更大的公开漏洞记录大多只含脆弱函数；混合两者会让数据来源预测标签，仅用标注数据训练则得到常把固定函数排在脆弱原版之上的模型。我们提出 Cyber-JEV 微调方法：用修复提交把这些记录变成对比组，每组含一个脆弱函数、其补丁版与同文件至多两个未变函数，让模型看到移除已记录缺陷的改动。一个共享模型学习两个任务：对标注参照数据分类，以及把组内脆弱函数排在其他成员之上；测试时输入一个函数、输出漏洞分数。在 7,270 个函数的测试基准上，五个微调 Qwen3.5-4B 的集成达到 AUROC 0.814，而 Jev 1.13 为 0.743；以 Jev 的 4,031 条告警为审查预算，它漏掉 322 个脆弱函数中的 16 个而非 39 个。与仅在参照数据上训练相比，它在三组真实修复上把「脆弱版排在补丁版之上」的比率提高 14.8–29.2 个百分点。此类分数可在固定预算下为 pull request 或发布中的变更函数排定审查顺序。
summary_cn: 用修复提交构造「脆弱-补丁-未变」对比组微调开源模型做漏洞评分：5×Qwen3.5-4B 集成 AUROC 0.814（Jev 0.743），同预算漏检 16/322 vs 39/322，三组真实修复排序优势 +14.8–29.2 个百分点。
objective_summary: 以修复提交构建对比组解决漏洞检测数据集的标签-来源混淆，联合分类与组内排序两任务微调开源模型，并在固定告警预算下量化审查收益。
evidence_note: 7,270 函数测试基准+三组真实修复的排序评估、与 Jev 1.13 同预算对比（漏检 16 vs 39/322）、数据构造动机清晰；无统计检验，基准仍为公开基准组合。
novelty_note: 核心贡献是数据构造层面的：用修复提交对比组消除「数据来源预测标签」的训练偏差，是对漏洞评分模型训练方式的实质性改进。
scope: 结论适用于函数级源代码漏洞评分与审查排序场景；对跨函数/跨文件漏洞与测试时代码风格漂移未覆盖。
limitations: 修复提交质量参差可能引入噪声；对比组构造依赖能定位修复 diff；仅在 C/C++ 类基准与 4B 模型规模验证。

title: Leakage-Aware Encrypted Semantic Communication with Key-Conditioned Signal Perturbation
abstract: Encrypted semantic communication systems protect transmitted messages by inserting key-conditioned modules into a deep-learning semantic communication pipeline, but existing designs rely on a fixed adversarial weight and operate mainly at the semantic-feature level. We propose two changes to the encrypted semantic communication system (ESCS): a key-conditioned signal-domain perturbation layer, called learned adversarial perturbation injection (LAPI), and an information noise-contrastive estimation (InfoNCE)-guided adaptive training rule that {adds an adaptive leakage penalty alongside the fixed adversarial objective} using an InfoNCE-based proxy for mutual information leakage. Experiments on the Europarl corpus over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and Rayleigh fading channels show that InfoNCE-guided training is the primary source of eavesdropper suppression, reducing the eavesdropper's bilingual evaluation understudy (BLEU) score to approximately 0.07 at high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Adding LAPI to the InfoNCE-guided objective further lowers the InfoNCE-estimated leakage by 5-9% with low measured inference overhead, while its impact on legitimate-receiver BLEU depends on channel conditions. The two mechanisms operate on different parts of the pipeline and can be jointly applied.
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
title_cn: 泄漏感知的加密语义通信：密钥条件信号扰动
abstract_cn: 加密语义通信系统通过在深度学习语义通信管线中插入密钥条件模块保护传输消息，但现有设计依赖固定对抗权重且主要在语义特征层运作。我们对加密语义通信系统（ESCS）做两项改动：密钥条件信号域扰动层 LAPI（学习型对抗扰动注入），以及信息噪声对比估计（InfoNCE）引导的自适应训练规则——用基于 InfoNCE 的互信息泄漏代理，在固定对抗目标之外加入自适应泄漏惩罚。在 Europarl 语料上加性白高斯噪声（AWGN）与瑞利衰落信道上的实验显示：InfoNCE 引导训练是窃听者抑制的主要来源，在高信噪比下把窃听者的双语评估 understudy（BLEU）分数降到约 0.07；在 InfoNCE 引导目标上叠加 LAPI 进一步把 InfoNCE 估计的泄漏降低 5–9% 且推理开销低，而其对合法接收者 BLEU 的影响取决于信道条件。两个机制作用于管线不同部分，可联合应用。
summary_cn: 为加密语义通信加入密钥条件信号域扰动 LAPI 与 InfoNCE 泄漏自适应惩罚：Europarl 语料 AWGN/瑞利信道上窃听者 BLEU 被压到约 0.07（高 SNR），叠加 LAPI 再降泄漏 5–9% 且开销低。
objective_summary: 在加密语义通信管线加入信号域密钥条件扰动层与 InfoNCE 泄漏惩罚训练规则，在 AWGN/瑞利信道上量化窃听者抑制、泄漏降低与合法接收质量影响。
evidence_note: 标准语料（Europarl）+两类信道（AWGN/瑞利）的系统实验，机制分解消融清晰（InfoNCE 为主、LAPI 边际 5–9%）；IEEE GLOBECOM 2026 录用；仿真信道、无实测与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把扰动从语义特征层下沉到信号域并密钥条件化，加上以互信息代理的自适应泄漏惩罚，是对既有 ESCS 设计的实质性组合改进。
scope: 结论适用于文本语义传输的深度学习语义通信窃听防护仿真设定；对图像/语音模态、真实无线测试台与强自适应窃听者未覆盖。
limitations: 窃听者模型限于标准 eavesdropper 假设；LAPI 对合法 BLEU 的影响随信道波动；InfoNCE 泄漏代理与真实互信息的差距未量化。

title: Evaluating autonomous self-healing against persistent cyber-attacks
abstract: The need for autonomous cyber resilience (ACR) is strongly accelerating. The boost in cyber capabilities of advanced AI is speeding up the attacker-defender rat race to an unprecedented pace. As a result, the field of ACR must progress from early design and experimentation to hands-on evaluation and deployment. To illustrate what is needed for this transition, we put TNO's autonomous immune system-inspired Self-Healing for Cyber Security (SH4CS) software to the test. Our analytic and experimental evaluation results demonstrate that effective cyber resilience is achieved with SH4CS for (repeated) web application vulnerability exploits. Remaining challenges of SH4CS revolve around finding the right balance between predictable resilient behaviour, and adaptiveness to the large variety of cyber threats and applications-to-be-protected.
comment: Presented at AutonomousCyber 2026 workshop on 18 September 2026 and accepted for the workshop proceedings
title_cn: 评估针对持续网络攻击的自主自愈能力
abstract_cn: 对自主网络韧性（ACR）的需求正在强烈加速。先进 AI 网络能力的提升正把攻防竞赛加速到前所未有的程度。因此 ACR 领域必须从早期设计与实验过渡到动手评估与部署。为说明这一过渡所需，我们把 TNO 的自免疫式「网络安全自愈」（SH4CS）软件投入实测。我们的分析与实验评估结果表明：对（重复的）Web 应用漏洞利用，SH4CS 能实现有效的网络韧性；SH4CS 的剩余挑战围绕在可预测的韧性行为与对大量多样威胁及被保护应用的适应性之间找到平衡。
summary_cn: 对 TNO 自免疫式 SH4CS 自愈系统做分析+实验评估：对（重复的）Web 应用漏洞利用可实现有效网络韧性；剩余挑战在可预测韧性行为与威胁适应性之间的平衡。
objective_summary: 以分析与实验相结合评估 TNO SH4CS 自愈系统对 Web 应用漏洞利用（含重复利用）的检测-修复能力，并总结向部署过渡的挑战。
evidence_note: 单一系统、Web 应用漏洞利用场景的 workshop 论文（AutonomousCyber 2026），摘要未给出量化指标（检测率/修复时间/攻击类型数），评估深度有限。
novelty_note: 对既有自愈系统的实测评估，属把 ACR 从设计推向评估的示例性工作；无新方法或新发现。
scope: 结论适用于 SH4CS 在 Web 应用漏洞利用场景的韧性评估；对其他攻击类型与生产环境部署未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击场景限于 Web 应用漏洞利用；可预测性与适应性的权衡只有定性讨论；无与其他 ACR 系统的对比。

title: Rethinking Neural Decompilation: Candidate Selection as the Hidden Bottleneck
abstract: Reverse engineering obfuscated binaries is a core task in malware analysis and software security auditing. While neural decompilers based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved the readability and functional fidelity of recovered code over heuristic tools such as Ghidra and IDA Pro, a substantial gap remains between best-sample performance and practical single-output accuracy, particularly under code obfuscation. We study this gap through the lens of candidate generation and candidate selection. Using the LLM4Decompile architecture, we show that ground-truth tokens lie within the model's top-five next-token predictions in 95.6% of positions on average and that multi-sample decoding reaches a pass@100 of 93% on HumanEval-Decompile, indicating that correct reconstructions are typically already present in the model's sampling space. We then evaluate a generate-then-select pipeline that ranks 100 candidates per input with text-, syntax-, embedding-, consensus-, and likelihood-based selectors. Negative perplexity emerges as the strongest static selector on HumanEval-Decompile (73.3% pass@1), while execution-guided selection nearly closes the oracle gap on ExeBench (86.3% pass@1). Combined with one epoch of fine-tuning on our newly released ExeBench-Obfuscated dataset containing 362,647 obfuscated OLLVM samples, the same pipeline increases the pass@1 rate for obfuscated binaries to 88.8%, directly contradicting prior claims that released LLM4Decompile checkpoints are unsuitable for obfuscated inputs.

title_cn: 反思神经反编译：候选选择是被隐藏的瓶颈
abstract_cn: 对混淆二进制的逆向工程是恶意软件分析与软件安全审计的核心任务。基于大语言模型（LLM）的神经反编译器在恢复代码的可读性与功能保真度上已超过 Ghidra、IDA Pro 等启发式工具，但在代码混淆下，最佳采样表现与实际单输出准确率之间仍存在显著差距。我们通过候选生成与候选选择的透镜研究该差距。使用 LLM4Decompile 架构，我们显示真值词元平均在 95.6% 的位置落在模型 top-5 下一词元预测内，多采样解码在 HumanEval-Decompile 上达到 93% 的 pass@100，说明正确重建通常已存在于模型采样空间。随后评估「生成后选择」管线：以文本、语法、嵌入、共识与似然五类选择器对每输入 100 个候选排序。负困惑度是 HumanEval-Decompile 上最强的静态选择器（73.3% pass@1），而执行引导选择在 ExeBench 上几乎关闭 oracle 差距（86.3% pass@1）。结合在我们新发布的 ExeBench-Obfuscated 数据集（362,647 个混淆 OLLVM 样本）上的一个 epoch 微调，同一管线把混淆二进制的 pass@1 提高到 88.8%，直接反驳了「已发布 LLM4Decompile 检查点不适合混淆输入」的既有论断。
summary_cn: 分析 LLM 反编译瓶颈在候选选择而非生成：真值词元 95.6% 位置在 top-5 内、pass@100 达 93%；执行引导选择 ExeBench 86.3% pass@1，配合新发布的 36 万混淆样本集把混淆二进制 pass@1 提到 88.8%。
objective_summary: 把 LLM 反编译的性能差距归因到候选选择：量化采样空间覆盖率、对比五类选择器，发布 36 万混淆样本数据集并验证微调+选择管线的混淆代码恢复率。
evidence_note: ICICS 2026 已发表；多基准（HumanEval-Decompile/ExeBench/混淆集）量化、五类选择器系统对比、新数据集 362,647 样本公开；结论直接反驳既有论断并给出证据。
novelty_note: 重新定位瓶颈（生成已含正确答案、选择是短板）具诊断价值；ExeBench-Obfuscated 为该方向首个大规模混淆反编译数据集；管线本身为已有技术组合。
scope: 结论适用于 LLM4Decompile 架构与 OLLVM 混淆的 C 函数反编译；对其他架构、语言与混淆器，以及语义级等价判定的边界未覆盖。

title: Movable Antenna-Assisted Secret Key Generation over Temporally Correlated Channels
abstract: Physical-layer key generation (PLKG) exploits reciprocal channel dynamics to generate symmetric keys, addressing the key distribution problem in wireless communications. However, strong temporal correlation in slow-fading environments limits fresh randomness and results in low key generation rates. Movable antennas (MAs) introduce spatial degrees of freedom through antenna repositioning, providing a new approach to addressing the limitation. This paper investigates MA-assisted PLKG over temporally correlated channels. A first-order Gauss-Markov process is utilized to characterize the temporal correlation of multipath gains. We characterize the full-sequence mutual information (MI) over temporally correlated channels. For fixed antenna positions and beamforming, we establish a finite-horizon approximation error bound that vanishes as both effective signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) increase. We derive a closed-form expression for the one-step conditional MI and adopt it as a tractable key-information metric. A nonconvex problem is formulated to jointly optimize antenna positions and per-slot beamforming under transmit-power and minimum-spacing constraints. We develop an alternating optimization algorithm, combining an exact principal-eigenvector beamforming solution with feasible SCA-based projected gradient position updates. Simulation results demonstrate that the MA-assisted scheme outperforms the fixed-position antenna baseline. At a high temporal correlation coefficient, position optimization achieves approximately $51\%$ higher rates than fixed antennas. Joint position and beamforming optimization provides a further $106\%$ gain over position optimization alone, demonstrating more pronounced gains under strong temporal correlation.
title_cn: 时变相关信道上的可移动天线辅助物理层密钥生成
abstract_cn: 物理层密钥生成（PLKG）利用互易信道动态生成对称密钥，解决无线通信中的密钥分发问题。但慢衰落环境中的强时间相关性限制了新鲜随机性，导致低密钥生成速率。可移动天线（MA）通过天线重定位引入空间自由度，为解决该限制提供新途径。本文研究时变相关信道上的 MA 辅助 PLKG。用一阶高斯-马尔可夫过程刻画多径增益的时间相关性；刻画时变相关信道上的全序列互信息（MI）。对固定天线位置与波束成形，建立随有效信噪比增大而消失的有限时域近似误差界。推导一步条件互信息的闭式表达式并将其作为可处理的密钥信息度量。在发射功率与最小间距约束下建立联合优化天线位置与逐时隙波束成形的非凸问题；开发结合精确主特征向量波束成形解与可行 SCA 投影梯度位置更新的交替优化算法。仿真结果表明 MA 辅助方案优于固定位置天线基线：在高时间相关系数下，仅位置优化即比固定天线获得约 51% 的速率提升；位置与波束成形联合优化再比仅位置优化提升 106%，在强时间相关下增益更显著。
summary_cn: 研究可移动天线辅助物理层密钥生成：高斯-马尔可夫刻画时间相关性并联合优化天线位置与逐时隙波束成形；高相关下位置优化较固定天线提升约 51%，联合优化再增 106%。
objective_summary: 为慢衰落高相关信道建模 MA 辅助 PLKG：互信息刻画、闭式一步条件 MI、非凸联合优化问题与交替求解算法，仿真量化相对固定天线的速率增益。
evidence_note: 理论推导完整（近似误差界+闭式表达式）并有多组仿真对照（固定天线/仅位置/位置+波束，51%/106% 增益）；全部为仿真结果，无实测、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把可移动天线的空间自由度引入时间相关性受限的 PLKG 是已有组件的新场景组合；优化框架为交替式经典方法。
scope: 结论适用于慢衰落高时间相关环境下的点对点无线密钥生成仿真设定；对实测信道、多用户与硬件实现误差未覆盖。
limitations: 纯仿真验证；高斯-马尔可夫假设对真实信道拟合有限；可移动天线的机械重定位延迟与成本未纳入。

title: ATrust: Adaptive Trust Boundary Expansion for Securing LLM Agents
abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents take on more complex tasks with greater autonomy, security has become a major obstacle to their broader deployment. Unlike in attacks that require complex exploitation of operating system vulnerabilities, attackers can easily hijack agents through indirect prompt injection (IPI), leading to privacy leakage, financial loss, and destructive operations. However, existing defenses often make security decisions based on limited static trusted evidence or assess observations in isolation. Such rigid trust assumptions can cause task-essential information to be unnecessarily discarded, resulting in over-defense and degraded agent functionality. To address this problem, we propose ATrust, a defense mechanism that adaptively expands the trust boundary during agent runtime. Starting from the user query as the root trust anchor, ATrust evaluates external observations against the current trust boundary and execution state, progressively admitting task-essential information as new trust anchors. This preserves necessary environmental feedback while excluding irrelevant content, whether benign or malicious, from subsequent decision-making, thereby limiting unnecessary exposure to external environment. We evaluate ATrust on AgentDojo and AgentDyn, where it achieves the strongest overall security--utility trade-off among existing defenses. With GPT-4o as the engine model, ATrust reduces the attack success rate on AgentDyn from 37.80% to 4.37% while enhancing utility by 10.00%, outperforming AuthGraph, the state-of-the-art defense, by 12.33%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of ATrust.
title_cn: ATrust：面向 LLM 智能体安全的自适应信任边界扩展
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体以更高自主性承担更复杂任务，安全成为其更广泛部署的主要障碍。与需要复杂利用操作系统漏洞的攻击不同，攻击者可以轻易通过间接提示注入（IPI）劫持智能体，导致隐私泄漏、财务损失与破坏性操作。然而现有防御常基于有限的静态信任证据做安全决策，或孤立评估观测，这种僵化信任假设会把任务必要信息不必要地丢弃，造成过度防御与智能体功能退化。为解决该问题，我们提出 ATrust，一种在智能体运行时自适应扩展信任边界的防御机制。从作为根信任锚的用户查询出发，ATrust 针对当前信任边界与执行状态评估外部观测，渐进接纳任务必要信息作为新信任锚。这既保留必要的环境反馈，又把无关内容（无论良性或恶意）排除在后续决策之外，从而限制对外部环境的不必要暴露。我们在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 上评估 ATrust：它取得既有防御中最强的整体安全-效用折中。以 GPT-4o 为引擎模型，ATrust 把 AgentDyn 上的攻击成功率从 37.80% 降到 4.37%，同时效用提升 10.00%，比最先进防御 AuthGraph 高 12.33%。这些结果展示了 ATrust 的有效性与实用性。
summary_cn: 提出 ATrust 防御：以用户查询为根信任锚、运行时渐进接纳任务必要信息为新锚；GPT-4o 下 AgentDyn 攻击成功率 37.80%→4.37%、效用 +10.00%，超 SOTA AuthGraph 12.33%。
objective_summary: 设计运行时自适应信任边界扩展机制：以查询为根锚、按执行状态渐进接纳任务必要观测，并在 AgentDojo/AgentDyn 上与既有防御量化对比。
evidence_note: 两个基准（AgentDojo/AgentDyn）、与 SOTA 防御 AuthGraph 直接对比并给出具体数字（ASR 37.80%→4.37%、效用 +10.00%、领先 12.33%）；无统计检验，基准场景有限。
novelty_note: 从「静态信任证据/孤立观测评估」转向「运行时渐进信任锚扩展」，机制方向有新意；与既有防御同属 IPI 治理路线，属实质性改进而非新范式。
scope: 结论适用于工具调用型 LLM 智能体在间接提示注入下的防御评估（AgentDojo/AgentDyn 场景）；对多智能体与持续记忆污染场景未覆盖。
limitations: 信任接纳判据的错误可能引入新型攻击面；仅在两个基准上验证；对长时程任务的累计信任漂移未分析。

title: The Customer Never Sees the Goal: Measuring and Detecting Vulnerability-Targeted Manipulation in LLM Assistants
abstract: Companies deploy large language model (LLM) assistants on their websites to advise customers. For commercial reasons, the operator can give an assistant a goal that the customer never sees. This paper focuses on operator-induced vulnerability-targeted manipulation (VTM), in which an assistant pursues such a goal by exploiting a vulnerability the customer discloses. While existing research mainly measures how manipulative a model is, we go further and ask whether VTM can be detected from the customer-AI conversation. To investigate this at scale, we introduce GAP (Goal-Anchored Probing). GAP first records the option a model recommends without any goal and then sets the other option as the operator's goal. We apply GAP to 15 open- and closed-source LLMs and collect 619,600 labeled replies across 540 everyday scenarios in 12 domains. We organize our study around three research questions. (1) Do assistants with an operator goal target vulnerable customers? (2) Can VTM be detected from the customer-AI conversation? (3) Does detection generalize to unseen models, vulnerabilities, and instruction styles? We first find that 14 of 15 models push the operator goal, and 12 of them use disclosed distress or financial strain to support it. Next, we show that fine-tuned detectors identify exploitative pushes with 79\% accuracy from the reply alone, while zero-shot LLM judges average at most 62\%. Finally, detection weakens on vulnerabilities absent from training. Telling whether a push comes from the operator also becomes unreliable when the assistant is told to hide its goal. We will release our dataset and code to facilitate future research on auditing LLM assistants.
